newsitem.title: CANADA: Elk Point bids for Truax.
newsitem.headline: Elk Point bids for Truax.

text.p: Elk Point Resources Inc said on Monday it entered into an agreement to acquire Truax Resources Corp for C$2.23 cash or 0.314 of an Elk Point share for each Truax share.
Elk Point said Truax's board of directors determined that its proposal was superior to an offer by Saxon Petroleum Inc, which was expected to expire on Tuesday.
Truax's board had previously rejected the Saxon offer.
Elk point said shareholders who tendered to the Saxon bid had the right to withdraw their shares before midnight MDT on April 8.

It said the cash portion of its bid was subject to a maximum of C$10 million and if all shareholders opted for cash they would receive about 24 percent of their consideration in cash and the rest in shares.
If a competing bid was successful in taking Truax, Elk Point would be paid a break fee of C$1.5 million, it said.
Elk Point said the deal would be carried out by an amalgamation with a Truax shareholder vote slated for early June.
"The Truax properties compliment Elk Point's exploration and exploitation opportunities in its west central and southeastern Alberta core areas," Elk point said.
